Mapudungun

in its own words: Mapudungun

Find it on the globe

Speakers
250 thousand
Family
Araucanian
Vitality
Definitely endangered
Where it is spoken
Argentina, Chile
Script
Latin

Fun fact

Mapudungun means “speech of the land”. The Mapuche resisted both the Inca and the Spanish, who recognised their independence in the Treaty of Quilín (1641); Chile subdued them only in 1861–1883.
